## Activity

During January 2022, Market Eye Clinic completed 317 captures. This activity represents the recorded screening work undertaken at the site during the month. The service maintained its capture activity across the reporting period, with all completed captures submitted for image assessment and subsequent grading.

## Image quality

Graders identified 24 captures as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.6 of all captures. These images could not proceed through the standard grading process and were recorded separately from images suitable for assessment. No new equipment faults were reported by staff during the month.

## Grading

A total of 67 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 17 days. This measure summarises the time taken for results to reach grading and provides an indication of the service’s reporting timeliness during January 2022. Activity, image quality and grading outcomes should continue to be monitored through routine site review.
